ignoreValues.reason: img#dImg and the modal/lightbox imgs carry no src by design: openDetails() and updateFsImage() set it at runtime, and handleImgError/handleImgLoad provide the branded fallback. Documented in CLAUDE.md under 'Image error recovery'.

h1::after is a shimmer HIGHLIGHT sweeping over solid-coloured text (mix-blend-mode:overlay), not gradient-filled type: the h1 itself is color:var(--text-main). Pre-existing brand decoration, and the prefers-reduced-motion block already stops it via *::after.
